title: Normteile cuts the allocation for Stud bolt M10 A2-70
briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Normteile Brucker KG. Normteile cuts the allocation for Stud bolt M10 A2-70. Need: 239490 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 8 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 11. Prepare from the data package.
